title: research: nine-line counterexample to the B2 acyclic-edge strengthening
body:
## Result

An explicit **nine-line** admissible three-total configuration has `H=empty`, `|F|=v=9`, and

```
cost(B) = 7 + 7 + 7 = 21 < masE(W[F]) = 27.
```

This answers **open next question 1 of #2293**: the acyclic-edge-count strengthening of B2(iii) is false. The vertex interpretation has `masV=3` and is not contradicted. The full wild pattern equals the chosen pairing's off-diagonal support, so restricting to B-supported wild edges does not repair the edge version.

The construction repeats each of three full-support rational biorthogonal pairs k times and takes `I_k` diagonal / `J_k` off-diagonal blocks. The included proof gives rank `3k` for even k and `3k-2` for odd k, while `masE=3k^2`; every **k >= 3** is a counterexample. This explains the failure: repetition makes the edge count quadratic while the rank cost stays linear.

## Reviewable package

`research/b2-tripartite-edge-counterexample/` contains the literal witness, elementary all-k proof, independent standard-library verifier, source pins, task/overlap record, and registered normal/optimized replay.

The verifier checks every dot product and pairing entry, derives ranks by elimination **and full row-space enumeration**, computes masE by exact subset DP over all vertex orders, and computes masV by induced-subgraph cycle tests. It includes four malformed-input controls, rank/cycle controls, two reindexings, k=1,2 tight/nonviolating controls, and rank-formula checks through k=16. The universal result rests on the proof, not the finite checks.

## Evidence

Passed locally on Windows x86-64, **CPython 3.12.13**, no third-party dependencies:

```sh
python3.12 -B research/b2-tripartite-edge-counterexample/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/b2-tripartite-edge-counterexample --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/b2-tripartite-edge-counterexample
```

The registered replay passed both normal and `-O` commands. `research_baseline.py` passed the source-binding orientation on CPython 3.13.15; this is not the full selected-frontier cold replay. `git diff --check` passed. Hosted CI and independent maintainer review are separate from this local evidence.

- Credit: DreamingOfClouds's #2162 model/B2 at `113a718265c62aec301c5695f4bfb9c421bef7ab`; Aaron Wang/opencode's #2293 distinction and question at `6bc48613ed1c71e5d2e88994235e9e8629129b9c`. Both heads were rechecked unchanged.

Repeated indexed vectors are permitted by the stated model. No globally smallest-v counterexample, globally minimum-cost pairing, physical supplier, new kappa, or contradiction to target (A) is claimed. The selected frontier and all frozen predecessors are untouched.
